policy.principle: A public landing page is not blanket permission to redistribute or train on every linked artifact. Source availability, source license, artifact license, and intended-use permission are distinct.

sources.title: Evaluation of tomato breeding lines under organic and low-input conditions in Portugal (2023)
sources.observed_metadata: The record describes a downloadable XLSX trial workbook. The rendered record has no clearly populated license field.
sources.next_gate: Inspect exact record metadata and artifact terms; if authorized, download and pin the file digest before inspecting workbook schema.

sources.title: Tomato shuttle-breeding, sensory and ideotype-selection trials in Portugal (2024–2025)
sources.observed_metadata: The record describes a downloadable XLSX. The rendered Rights/License fields do not clearly specify an artifact license.
sources.next_gate: Inspect exact record metadata, related study terms and artifact terms; download only after use is authorized.

sources.title: Horti-M3-Tomato multi-year multimodal cultivation dataset
sources.observed_metadata: The 2026 article describes a public dataset and states research/educational reuse; verify the Zenodo artifact's own license, subfile terms, and third-party content before processing or redistribution. The 2026 paper describes the source as a greenhouse study in Northeast China with one integrated monitoring station; treat it as a temporal/multimodal evaluation candidate, not independent geographic replication or evidence of South African transfer.
sources.next_gate: Fetch dataset-specific API metadata, inspect files/licenses/README, and record exact terms and SHA-256 digests for the authorized subset.
sources.initial_intended_role: Multimodal sensor/image/phenotype alignment; assess held-out planting cycles or seasons only if experimental grouping supports it. Geography-transfer claim is out of scope.

sources.title: TomatoMAP multi-angle / multi-pose tomato phenotyping dataset and paper
sources.observed_metadata: Article metadata reports open licensing; dataset files and possible third-party exceptions must be verified independently.
sources.next_gate: Inspect article data availability, downloadable artifact license and any third-party annotation/image restrictions.

sources.title: South African Agricultural Research Council indigenous/traditional leafy-vegetable research programme
sources.observed_metadata: Program page establishes research scope, not the existence of a freely downloadable raw trial dataset.
sources.next_gate: Contact through official institutional channels to ask about relevant trial records, terms, crop priorities, and collaboration.

sources.title: Genesys Plant Genetic Resources database
reported_content: available descriptors and trait data, depending on collection
sources.observed_metadata: API documentation describes token-based access; collection terms and material-transfer conditions remain accession/collection-specific.
sources.next_gate: Establish API access and terms, then inspect accession-level records and provider-specific restrictions.

sources.title: FAOSTAT food and agriculture statistics
reported_content: prices and other published series, dependent on dataset
sources.observed_metadata: Useful for context and macro-level baselines, not cultivar-level replicated trial outcomes. Each series needs units, geography, vintage and definition.
sources.next_gate: Record exact dataset series, data vintage, units, geography, terms and file digest before using it in a scored run.

sources.title: Plant Phenotyping Datasets portal
reported_content: links to plant image / annotation datasets and tasks
sources.observed_metadata: This is a catalogue; each linked dataset has its own license, annotation protocol, and split rules.
sources.next_gate: Choose one concrete dataset only after per-dataset license, annotation/split rules, and applicability are reviewed.

sources.title: Mycelix ProductiveLoop and lettuce/DWC cultivar-admission project contracts
sources.observed_metadata: Implementation/design references for integration; not third-party biological outcome observations.
sources.next_gate: Crosswalk canonical types and invariant IDs; never count these contracts as crop-performance data.
